renewable.note: Solar, wind, biomass, hydropower and other renewables as a share of all electricity generated in Germany so far today. Pumped storage doesn't count as renewable.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.intro: Any series over any time range, shareable by link.

explain.title: Explain a day
explain.intro: Ask about a day on the electricity market. Answers come from the same data as the charts.

assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.emptyIntro: Ask about generation, prices or the renewable share. Try one of these:

starters.priceRange: What was the day-ahead price range yesterday?
starters.windSolar: How much electricity did wind and solar produce yesterday?
starters.updated: When was the data last updated?

assistant.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.
assistant.truncated: The answer reached its length limit and may be cut off.
assistant.privacy: Your questions are sent to Google's Gemini service (free tier), which may use them to improve its products. Please don't enter personal data. The assistant can be wrong: check important figures in the charts.

errors.rate_limited: The assistant has used up its free quota for now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: The model service isn't available right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.blocked: The model declined to answer this question. Try asking it differently.
errors.failed: Something went wrong while answering. Please try again.
errors.off: The assistant is switched off at the moment.
errors.busy: Too many questions right now. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid: That question couldn't be sent. Try a shorter one.
errors.network: The connection was interrupted. Please try again.
